content: If you miss a dose of the medication, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and proceed with your next dose at the regular time. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one. Store this medication at room temperature, ensuring it is kept away from direct light and moisture. Avoid storing it in the bathroom. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. When the product is expired or no longer needed, dispose of it properly according to local regulations or guidelines. The information provided here was last updated in August 2024.
